public_rationale: Anthropic's audited historical losses support the statement for that company. Alphabet's consolidated profits show why the company boundary matters. Neither establishes how many relevant model builders were losing money or had previously profited. The missing population coverage and unspecified accounting basis prevent a fair majority verdict.
limitations: Anthropic's historical results were disclosed after the post but before the evaluation date.
The annual target period is an evaluator interpretation of an ongoing observation.
The two clauses require different historical coverage.
Profitable diversified parents do not by themselves contradict losses from model building.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Most GenAI model-building companies are losing money and few have made any profit.

statement.excerpt: (Or nil; most are losing money; few have made any profits at all).
statement.document_title: GenAI’s day of reckoning may have come

from_speaker: few have made any profits at all
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that a majority by company count were loss-making, and only a small minority had ever earned bottom-line profits.
For current losses, I use the latest completed annual reporting period before publication: calendar 2024, or the corresponding company fiscal year.
The historical profits clause additionally requires earlier records through the post date; a single annual loss cannot establish that a company never profited.
The source does not indicate an accounting basis or clearly define the company population.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records for a defined representative population establish losses at a majority in the target period and prior profits at only a small minority.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that a majority were not loss-making in the target period, or that prior profits were widespread rather than confined to a small minority.

evidence.publisher: Anthropic, PBC / US Securities and Exchange Commission
evidence.explanation: The accompanying risk disclosure reports a 2024 net loss of $8.3 billion and losses in every year since founding. This supports the description for Anthropic, but one company cannot establish the population claim and the contract supplies no matching accounting basis.

evidence.locator: Opening financial highlights; Consolidated Statements of Income, page 5
evidence.explanation: Alphabet reports positive consolidated net income for the quarter and year. This is material contrary context under a broad whole-company reading, but it neither isolates GenAI model-building profits nor establishes a majority.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A defined population and accounting basis, comparable target-year bottom-line results covering that population, and historical records sufficient to assess prior profitability.
